title: AgentOps Cross-Family Pawl Verdict v1
description: The machine-checkable, EVIDENCE-BOUND and COMMIT-BOUND cross-family verdict that authorizes a mutate-shared-trunk pawl (merge/push to main). Written by the /pre-land-refuters (or /council) gate after the panel runs; read by scripts/reconcile-pr.sh BEFORE it merges. Green CI is necessary but NOT sufficient: a merge requires this artifact to exist, be tied to THIS bead+PR+head_sha, carry BOTH cross-family refuters CONFIRMED, and carry real reviewer evidence (a transcript/evidence path that exists and is non-empty, or a council_artifact that exists). Fail-closed by construction: absent artifact, wrong bead/PR, stale head_sha, fewer than two KNOWN-roster distinct families, any non-CONFIRMED refuter, missing reviewer evidence, or an escalate/hold disposition => the gate refuses the merge. THREAT MODEL: this defends against a SLOPPY agent that skips the real review and self-stamps CONFIRMED — it requires that a review ACTUALLY RAN (evidence) against the CURRENT commit (head_sha) by two real families. It is NOT cryptographic provenance: there are no signatures, no peercred, no OS-level writer separation. Cryptographic un-forgeability against a hostile forger is INTENTIONALLY OUT OF SCOPE (single-operator trusted loop; the cut cathedral). The companion free-form council narrative lives at .agents/council/YYYY-MM-DD-pre-land-*.md; THIS file is the checkable summary the merge path enforces against. Runtime artifact lives at .agents/pawl-verdicts/<bead-id>.json (untracked); this schema and its fixtures are tracked.

bead_id.description: The bead this verdict authorizes. reconcile-pr.sh requires this to equal the bead it is closing.

pr.description: The PR number this verdict was produced against. reconcile-pr.sh requires this to equal the PR it is merging — a verdict for a different PR does not transfer.

head_sha.description: REQUIRED: the PR head commit the panel actually reviewed. reconcile-pr.sh fetches the PR's CURRENT head sha (gh pr view <PR> --json headRefOid) and refuses the merge if this != current — a verdict goes STALE the moment a new commit is pushed, so it can never be reused across a re-push. This is the COMMIT-BINDING half of the gate.

disposition.description: Panel-level disposition. CONFIRMED = both cross-family refuters confirmed and the panel authorizes the door. REFUTED = at least one refuter refuted; the gate REJECTED. The default REFUTED path is AUTO-REJECT -> AUTO-REDO: the loop sends the work back to be re-done with the findings and re-gates, with no human — continuous self-correction. ESCALATE / HOLD = a tunable CIRCUIT BREAKER tripped (max-attempts, time budget, cost/quota budget, or oscillation/no-forward-progress); the loop stops auto-redoing and HOLDs for a human. The disposition is ESCALATE/HOLD ONLY on a breaker trip, NOT on plain REFUTED. Only CONFIRMED authorizes the merge; everything else fail-closed HOLDs at the merge path.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the panel recorded this verdict.

attempt.description: Which re-gate attempt produced this verdict (default 1). A plain REFUTED auto-redoes (no human); the disposition only flips to ESCALATE/HOLD when a circuit breaker trips — e.g. the max-attempts breaker after N (default 3) re-work/re-gate cycles, or the time/cost/oscillation breakers. Never CONFIRMED on a streak of REFUTEDs.

refuters.description: The cross-family refuter panel. At least two refuters from at least two distinct model families, each prompted to refute, each read-only and stake-free. The merge requires EVERY refuter to be CONFIRMED and at least two distinct families represented.

family.description: The reviewer's model family, recorded as a label from the KNOWN alias roster (the writer stores the raw label as given). Aliases collapse to three CANONICAL families: fable/anthropic -> claude; codex/openai -> gpt; agy/google -> gemini. This enum admits the full alias set; pawl-verdict.sh `check` then lowercases + normalizes each label to its canonical family and rejects anything off-roster, so a fake/unknown label ('totally-real-family', 'x') is refused at check time — the '>=2 distinct families' rule cannot be gamed with junk strings. At least two DISTINCT CANONICAL families must appear across the refuters (e.g. claude + codex passes; claude + fable does not — both canonicalize to claude).

reviewer.description: Optional reviewer/session identifier (must differ from the authoring worker session).

verdict.description: This refuter's verdict. Both refuters must be CONFIRMED for the panel to authorize the door.

evidence.description: Path to this refuter's grounding evidence — the real reviewer run output (transcript), the pinned-fixture sweep, or the council narrative anchor. reconcile-pr.sh requires this file to EXIST and be NON-EMPTY (or the verdict's top-level council_artifact to exist). A verdict with no reviewer evidence anywhere is fail-closed: it reflects an assertion, not a review that actually ran. This is the EVIDENCE-BINDING half of the gate.

council_artifact.description: Optional path to the free-form council narrative (.agents/council/YYYY-MM-DD-pre-land-<slug>.md) this summary was distilled from.
